# three.js

three.min.js, OrbitControls.js and STLLoader.js draw the 3D preview in the configurator page.

- Version: three 0.128.0 (r128)
- From: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.128.0.tgz, files build/three.min.js,
  examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js and examples/js/loaders/STLLoader.js
- Integrity of the tarball: sha512-i0ap/E+OaSfzw7bD1TtYnPo3VEplkl70WX5fZqZnfZsE3k3aSFudqrrC9ldFZfYFkn1zwDmBcdGfiIm/hnbyZA==
  (matches the npm registry)
- Licence: MIT, see LICENSE

The files are unchanged from the tarball. They are served from this repo, not a CDN, so a
compromised CDN cannot change the page. examples/js is gone from three r148 and later: an
upgrade means moving to the examples/jsm modules.
